# Security Checklist: SPEC-014C First Real Harness Adapter Pilot

**Purpose**: Validate security requirement quality for the Codex app-server adapter, with focus on cwd sandboxing, secret detection, raw-payload exclusion, authorization, and safe subprocess construction.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
